zh:
复旦大学（Fudan University）成立于1905年，位于中国上海市杨浦区，是中国顶尖的公立研究型大学，也是中国双一流建设高校。学校下设29个学院，覆盖医学、经济、管理、新闻、法律、工程、人文社科、基础科学等全领域，在校生超40000人，其中研究生约19000名。
复旦大学以“博学而笃志，切问而近思”为校训，是中国南方人文社科与基础科学的学术重镇，培养了多位诺贝尔奖得主、菲尔兹奖得主，以及大批学术大师与国家栋梁。学校在医学、经济学、新闻学、数学、化学、计算机科学等领域稳居国内顶尖、世界前列，拥有多个国家级重点实验室与科研平台，科研成果丰硕。2026QS世界大学排名中，复旦大学位列世界第30位。
en: Fudan University is a top public research university in China. Founded in 1905, it is located in Yangpu District, Shanghai, and a key Double First-Class university in China. The University comprises 29 colleges, covering medicine, economics, management, journalism, law, engineering, humanities, social sciences, and basic sciences, with over 40,000 enrolled students, including 19,000 graduate students. Guided by the motto 'Rich in knowledge and tenacious of purpose, inquiring with earnestness and reflecting with self-practice', Fudan is a leading academic hub in China for humanities, social sciences, and basic sciences. It has produced multiple Nobel Prize winners and Fields Medalists. Ranked No.30 in the world in the 2026 QS World University Rankings.
